name: train-sk-ce-s1
description:
RQ7, training language: the cross-entropy model of RQ6 (`train-cs-sk-ce`) trained on
Slovak data only, to measure how training on one language transfers to the other.
Every UNER Slovak-SNK train example and 20,000 drawn from the OpenPII 1M Slovak train
split (about 20,900, against 22,308 for cs+sk), so the language changes and the amount
of data, the steps and every hyperparameter do not. Scored on the Czech and the Slovak
development splits. Its Czech twin is `train-cs-ce`.
